sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of a single value in the returned content of a component. N ranges from 1 to 5.

sub_parameters.name: Operator
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator for the component. N ranges from 1 to 5.

Valid values:
- Equal
- NotEqual
- BeginWith
- LessThan
- GreaterThan

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The values corresponding to the names in the component results. The first N ranges from 1 to 5. The second N ranges from 1 to 20.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: TypeName
parameters.description:
The component name.

Valid values:

- ACS:InstanceInformation
- ACS:Application
- ACS:File
- ACS:Network
- ACS:WindowsRole
- ACS:Service
- ACS:WindowsRegistry
- ACS:WindowsUpdate
